rationale: standards audit found the 4 EPMCDME-14982 commits use 'EPMCDME-14982 : <desc>' instead of git-workflow.md's '<type>: <desc>' format (CR-001, blocking); the new Windows activate-confirm test asserts only writes.slice(-1) instead of the full writes array like its sibling test, weakening the new regression guard (CR-002, patch/major). The acceptance lens's 'partial' on 'profile ends up active in config file' is reclassified here to pending-stage-7: the write of y\r is unit-tested and passing, and the remaining piece is external codemie-cli/filesystem behavior identical in kind to the already-pending-stage-7 manual Windows walkthrough, not something any code change in this diff can resolve. 3 edge-case findings dismissed as noise: two ask for additional Windows fixtures the spec never required (and which would need a real, not fabricated, PTY recording), one flags a hypothetical future pad(30) overflow with no current failing fixture. 0 deferred.

findings.title: Commit subjects violate conventional-commit format
findings.problem: All 4 commits in this range use 'EPMCDME-14982 : <description>' instead of the required '<type>: <short description>' (feat|fix|docs|test|chore|refactor, no ticket prefix).
findings.impact: Breaks the documented commit-format standard this repo squash-merges on; the ticket-prefix-with-space-colon pattern is not among the guide's listed exceptions.
findings.recommendation: Reword the squash-merge subject to '<type>: <short description>', e.g. 'test: add Windows real-stream tests for profile-name correction and activate confirm', dropping the ticket-number prefix.

findings.title: Activate-confirm test checks only the last write
findings.problem: The 'real stream (windows): the activate confirm is auto-answered...' test asserts writes.slice(-1) deepEquals ['y\r'] instead of the full writes array, unlike the sibling profile-name-correction test (line 910) which deepEquals the whole sequence.
findings.impact: An extra or duplicate write occurring before the final y\r (e.g. a double-answered confirm) would pass this test undetected, weakening the regression guard this new Windows coverage exists to add.
findings.recommendation: Assert the full writes array: assert.deepEqual(writes, ['default\r', ans('epmcdme-14982-capture-2784'), 'y\r']).
